verdict.rationale: Intel's ARK specifications page (and the runtime probe) confirms a machine-fetchable spec sheet listing clocks, cache, ECC support, vPro eligibility, and supported AI frameworks (OpenVINO, DirectML, ONNX RT), giving power-users concrete comparable data beyond marketing language. However, the evidence pack lacks explicit AI TOPS figures with stated test conditions, detailed base/turbo power figures, or memory speed/latency specs with test methodology, and much of the docs pack is marketing copy rather than spec data. missing for 10: explicit AI TOPS numbers with test conditions, full power/TDP breakdown, independent verification of spec accuracy.
